Umbrakinesis.title: Umbrakinesis
Umbrakinesis.description: You have obtained the power to manipulate darkness at will, becoming a denizen of darkness

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{pitch:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Umbrakinesis","color":"#2B0545","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}
item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with air

Secondary.Ability.title: Shadow Ball
Secondary.Ability.description: Shoot out a ball of darkness, blinding and damaging enemies

Darkness.Form.Unlock.title: Shadow Veil
Darkness.Form.Unlock.description: Transform into pure darkness, being able to fly and blind enemies

Shadow.Ensnare.Unlock.title: Umbra Threads
Shadow.Ensnare.Unlock.description: Encase enemies in darkness, preventing them from moving for a brief time. §dTargets the entity you are looking at

commands_on_entity_hit: execute if entity @e[distance=..3,limit=1,tag=!Ignore.Me,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity,tag=!Pitch,palladium.power=!eop:effects/ensnare_weak] run playsound minecraft:entity.illusioner.cast_spell ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 2 2
execute if entity @e[distance=..3,limit=1,tag=!Ignore.Me,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity,tag=!Pitch,palladium.power=!eop:effects/ensnare_weak] run particle dust 0 0 0 1 ~ ~1 ~ 1 1 1 1 50 force

execute if entity @e[distance=..3,limit=1,tag=!Ignore.Me,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity,tag=!Pitch,palladium.power=!eop:effects/ensnare] run playsound minecraft:entity.illusioner.cast_spell ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 2 2
execute if entity @e[distance=..3,limit=1,tag=!Ignore.Me,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity,tag=!Pitch,palladium.power=!eop:effects/ensnare] run particle dust 0 0 0 1 ~ ~1 ~ 1 1 1 1 50 force

Pure.Darkness.Unlock.title: Pure Darkness
Pure.Darkness.Unlock.description: Create a smokescreen of darkness, blinding enemies around

commands: execute at @s[type=!#eop:not_alive] run particle dust 0 0 0 3 ~ ~1 ~ 1 1 1 0 5 force
execute at @s[type=!#eop:not_alive] run particle dust 0 0 0 3 ~ ~1 ~ 1 1 1 0 5 force

Abyssal.Grip.Unlock.title: Abyssal Grip
Abyssal.Grip.Unlock.description: Create a patch of living shadow acting as a return point to travel back to at will. §dSneak §fto set or remove waypoint

Portal.title: Abyssal Grip
first_tick_commands: execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.bell master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Location marked!","color":"green","bold":true}]
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run tag @s add EOP.Portal.Saved

Portal.Switch.Begin.title: Abyssal Grip
first_tick_commands: execute unless predicate eop:is_sneaking run playsound minecraft:entity.evoker.prepare_attack master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute unless predicate eop:is_sneaking run tag @s add Shadow.Begin.Teleport
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Location removed!","color":"red","bold":true}]
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.snare master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run tag @s remove EOP.Portal.Saved

Null.Abyss.Unlock.title: Null Abyss
Null.Abyss.Unlock.description: Create a lightless domain, suffocating targets in darkness
